intervals.label: collaboration active (CANDLES III data taking)
intervals.note: Follows the experiment record; no source dates the formation of the collaboration. The 2020 paper is signed '(CANDLES Collaboration)'.
intervals.quote: The CANDLES III experiment is presently taking data since Spring 2013 at the Kamioka underground laboratory, Japan.

summary.plain: A Japanese collaboration led from Osaka University that runs the CANDLES calcium-48 double-beta-decay experiment in the Kamioka mine.
summary.technical: CANDLES Collaboration: RCNP and the Graduate School of Science of Osaka University, University of Fukui, Tokushima University, Osaka Sangyo University, Wakasa-wan Energy Research Center and University of Tsukuba (affiliations on arXiv:2008.09288).
